_comment: Claude Code plugins reviewed for this repository (docs/conventions/security-review.md § Plugins).
A plugin is used only at a reviewed commit. `reviewed` is the marketplace commit whose plugin
directory was read in full; `installed` is the commit the install actually copied — equal to
`reviewed`, or accepted after a compare between the two listed no file under the plugin's
directory. scripts/plugin-pins.mjs compares the machine's installed plugins with this file
(local gate only) and fails on a commit mismatch or on a `rejected` plugin being installed.
A bump = re-read the plugin directory at the new commit, then update reviewed / installed / date.
